free_tier.stated: Account creation is free ('Create Account') and the site offers 'Share any number of files in seconds. View over 200 file types online.'; no free allowance is given in the plan block.

per_object_cap.stated: 'No file size limits' is stated for all Kshared plans on the premium page; no numeric cap is published.

retention.stated: not stated on the page read

egress.terms: Every plan carries '35GB/Daily Bandwidth'. No per-byte price is stated; the plan price is flat.

interface_detail: Web drive ('CloudDrive'), web upload, and a share link. No API or FTP path is published on the pages read.
tooling: Browser only as read. Kshared is on the Leechall generator list, so a leecher is the fallback.
chaining: The same product as Emload at the same price, so a client picks whichever local-market releases it needs. 35 GB/day puts it in the top-up role, not the bulk role.

limits.value: 35 GB per day of download bandwidth
1 TB of storage on the 1-month plan

limits_note: All four tiers are visible on the premium page. The payment link is obtained through chat or an authorized reseller on Telegram.
binding_note: 35 GB/day against a 34.1 GB/day requirement for 1 TiB a month leaves under 1 GB a day of slack. Storage and transfer are the same figure, so a full month cannot keep a full month's data.

identity_cost.detail: Free signup through a Create Account page; paid plan at checkout. The payment link is provided by chat or an authorized reseller Telegram account; the checkout names PayPal and asks for VPN or proxy to be disabled.

reliability_note: Referral programme pays 20% of a referred user's purchase, which means the signup flow is built to be shared; treat any third-party 'free premium' offer for the host as an affiliate link.
confidence_note: Plan price and the daily bandwidth figure read on the vendor premium page today. The 3/6/12-month tiers were not expanded, so only the 1-month price is recorded.
